name: bizplug-fashion
description: The fashion & apparel plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: find sizes and reserve for try-on. It works from the business's own published profile, covering sizing, stock, shipping and returns, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Provided by BizPlug: https://www.bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.

interface.shortDescription: Find sizes and reserve for try-on for fashion & apparel businesses.
interface.longDescription: The fashion & apparel plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: find sizes and reserve for try-on. It works from the business's own published profile, covering sizing, stock, shipping and returns, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Provided by BizPlug: https://www.bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.
defaultPrompt: Find sizes and reserve for try-on
Do you have this in my size, and what's your returns policy?
How do I contact the business?

test_cases.expect: Calls show_menu, which shows the menu card; does not list the options again, or lists them exactly as returned where there is no card.

test_cases.prompt: Find sizes and reserve for try-on
test_cases.expect: Calls search_apparel and answers from the published profile.

test_cases.prompt: Do you have this in my size, and what's your returns policy?
test_cases.expect: Answers from the business profile, or says it is not covered and offers contact details.
Calls reserve_for_tryon only after the customer has confirmed the details, and reports that the business still has to confirm.
